tau_rated.semantic_note: Computed MTPA at MAX_I_S (250 A peak) should reach or exceed the ORNL dynamometer measurement (340 Nm at 250 A DC locked-rotor). The linear model over-predicts by ~166% at this current (constant L_q at 3.55 mH vs saturated ~2.5 mH), so the bound passes by a wide margin — the over-prediction is a documented saturation limitation, not a validation success. ORNL quote: 'A current amplitude of 250A produces about 340 Nm'.
